messages.subject: CPD seminar: Limitation and exclusion clauses after recent UCTA decisions
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

Our next in-house CPD seminar (1.5 hours, accredited) covers recent developments in the enforceability of limitation and exclusion clauses under UCTA 1977, with a focus on commercial supply and services contracts. Thursday 7 May, 12:30, Room 4 / Teams. Lunch provided. Register with L&D.

Best,
Learning & Development
